about: The collecta of the formulary “Sexagesima Sunday” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who seest that we put no trust in any deed of our own, mercifully grant that we may be strengthened against all adversity by the protection of the Doctor of the Gentiles. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
